spans.s: नुद् vt. 6U (pp. नुत्त or नुन्न; pres. नुदति-ते, प्रणुदति) 1. To push, to impel, मंदं मंदं नुदति पवनश्चानुकूलो यथा त्वाम् Megh.i.9; 2. to incite, to urge on; 3. to remove (संशयं) केयूरबंधोच्छ्वसितैर्नुनाद R.vi.68; 4. to throw, to send.With अप-, to drive away.With निस्-, 1. to reject, धाना मत्स्यान्पयो मांसं शाकं चैव न निर्नुदेत् M.iv.250; 2. to remove.With प्र-, to drive off, to dispel.With वि-, 1. to strike; 2. to play (on a musical instrument).With सम्-, 1. to collect; 2. to find.
नुद् Caus. (नोदयति-ते) to push on, to drive, to incite.With वि-, 1. to drive away, to dispel, to remove; 2. to pass away, to spend (as time); 3. to divert, to amuse, to entertain.
